title: A Comparative Multiparametric MRI Evaluation of Morphological Sequences, T2 Mapping, and Diffusion Imaging for the Characterisation of Healthy Knee Cartilage
summary: This supervised MSc Medical Physics study compared MRI methods for examining healthy knee cartilage.
The work includes morphological imaging, T2 mapping, and diffusion imaging. Its dataset has a public catalogue on drUM. Access to the underlying files is controlled.
